name: TCG Selva Cubica 2023
information: ### **IMPORTANTE** Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo. * Revisar la pestaña [Descripción](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TCGSelvaCubica2023#36169-descripcion-description) para conocer los medios de pago. * Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TCGSelvaCubica2023#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo. * Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TCGSelvaCubica2023/register) ### **IMPORTANT** You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament. * Check [Description](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TCGSelvaCubica2023#36169-descripcion-description) to know the payment methods. * Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TCGSelvaCubica2023#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram. * To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TCGSelvaCubica2023/register)
